Maya: quick heads-up 1: Helios onboarding stalled. They can't get audit logs into Datadog and their infra team just flagged KMS tagging doesn't match our scan. Also question about TLS syslog vs HTTPS collector endpoints. can we triage?
Diego: region + cloud? and what's failing on Datadog side (no traffic, rejected, or TLS handshake error)?
Helios (customer): running in azure-west-europe. we see TLS handshake failures to our collector endpoint (tcp/6514). logs show cert mismatch. we also don't have the KMS key tag the onboarding script looks for (purpose:audit).
Omar: cert mismatch often from SNI or the forwarded hostname. are they using an internal load balancer with hostname set? also for Azure KeyVault, our onboarding expects a key with tag purpose=logs and a managed identity granted 'wrapKey' permission.
Maya: short workaround if cert can't be fixed immediately: send logs over HTTPS to our in-region collector (hosted-forwarder) using mutual TLS. we can provide a client cert for a short-term exception. Customer compliance may accept with short rotation policy.
Helios (customer): compliance prefers no hosted flow. can we instead create a static egress IP list? their security team can only allow a set of IPs via firewall.
Diego: Azure NAT options: give them a SNAT on a NAT Gateway with Public IPs or use Azure Firewall with static public IP. small infra ask but straightforward. for TLS fix: ensure the LB hostname matches the cert CN or add SANs.
Omar: KMS/KeyVault specifics: example ARM/Terraform snippet for tag + access: 
```hcl
resource "azurerm_key_vault_key" "audit" {
  name = "helios-audit-key"
  key_vault_id = azurerm_key_vault.main.id
  tags = { purpose = "audit" env = "prod" }
}
resource "azurerm_role_assignment" "collector" {
  scope = azurerm_key_vault_key.audit.id
  role_definition_name = "Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User"
  principal_id = var.collector_sp_object_id
}
```
Omar: also confirm vault access policy allows sign/encrypt for the collector principal.
Maya: onboard-bot please run playbook privnet-onboard-checks for Helios and post results.
onboard-bot: executing playbook "privnet-onboard-checks:helios" 1: status: partial. audit-forwarding: FAILED (TLS cert mismatch), kms-tagging: FAILED (tag missing), network-egress: WARNING (no static public IPs detected). full report: /playbooks/6190012345-report
Diego: proposed immediate steps: 1) Helios to export LB hostname + cert subject (or attach cert to thread). 2) Helios infra to provision 1-2 static public IPs (NAT gw or firewall) and paste here. 3) Omar to share minimal KeyVault role snippet and a verification command.
Helios (customer): we'll try to get public IPs today. infra says they can do NAT Gateway with two IPs but need us to confirm destination ports for Datadog. What port should we list?
Maya: Datadog logs over TLS -> tcp/6514 (syslog TLS) or HTTPS ingestion -> tcp/443. If using TLS syslog, ensure firewall allows 6514 outbound to our datadog collector IPs (we'll provide).
Omar: verification command for KMS tag and access: `az keyvault key show --vault-name <vault> --name helios-audit-key --query tags` and `az role assignment list --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault>/keys/helios-audit-key`
Maya: renewal/health note: this is currently a Week0 blocker. if audit forwarding remains broken past the cutover window (7 days) we'll flag delivery risk; CS lead should schedule renewal touchpoint if we hit that threshold. prefer to avoid escalation.
Diego: also left a sample iptables/azure-nsg rule for reference: `az network nsg rule create --resource-group rg --nsg-name nsg-logs --name allow-datadog --priority 100 --direction Outbound --access Allow --protocol Tcp --destination-address-prefixes <datadog-ip> --destination-port-ranges 6514`
Helios (customer): copying the cert CN and nat eips now. thanks team.
Maya: action items summarized: 1) Helios to post cert CN + public IPs (due EOD 6190012600). 2) Omar to DM KeyVault role snippet & quick verification commands (due 6190012400). 3) Diego to send Datadog collector IPs + port options (due 6190012380). 4) Maya to update ticket and set follow-up reminder for 6190016000.
Helios (customer): will update here by EOD. appreciate the quick help. :pray:
